wall_edge_review.decision: Keep all 11 unmoved provisionally; measured overhangs are compatible with the documented approximate 1-2 m plan registration uncertainty. The Plan1086 wall remains the closest unresolved case.
wall_edge_review.limitation: Polygon and bounding-box checks do not establish actual wall-shell intersection, thickness containment, or survey-grade placement.

highest_priority_findings: Window openings read as opaque dark recesses; shader variants look indistinguishable, suggesting occluded or absent glazing geometry.
First-floor and core cutaway renders do not provide a legible view of the plan layout or room connectivity.
Interior coverage remains concentrated in a single classroom; core, stair, atrium circulation, and upper-floor rooms are not adequately verified.
The 1086 perimeter wall reaches 2.10 m outside the registered shell at a bbox corner and needs better plan-to-shell control points.
limitations: Google Maps is described in notes but no screenshot is preserved for reproducible review.
The 2003 archived interior photograph supplies historical context, not current-condition proof.
No upper-floor plans were available to validate upper-level interior layout.
